summary: Today's briefing highlights key legal rulings and significant developments in the retail sector, particularly focusing on consumer rights and corporate investments.

bullets.text: Allahabad High Court orders ₹1.25 lakh compensation for a man detained illegally for 5 days.
Bombay High Court grants patent for in-vivo power generator to an Indian scientist, overturning IIT's claims.
Chief Justice Vibhu Bahkru states that reviewing arbitral awards on merits undermines arbitration's purpose.
McDonald's India plans to invest approximately $80 million in growth and digitisation over the next two years.
Ferrero anticipates India will enter the top 10 global markets, focusing on premium chocolate segment growth.
